tagline: Handball champion who podcasts love and growth
summary: Lewis is a former pro athlete turned bestselling author who spends his off‑camera time coaching his twin girls, running a national handball team, and digging deep into mental‑health conversations. He blends high‑octane entrepreneurship with heartfelt spirituality, often sharing personal anxiety battles and gratitude prayers. Behind the brand, he’s a dad who loves salsa dancing, pumpkin patches, and building community around sport and wellbeing.
